variant.author: ElyFura
variant.changelog:
# Easy Chatlog

A Dalamud plugin for Final Fantasy XIV that captures your in-game chat, exports it
(`.txt` / `.json` / `.html` / `.md`) and optionally forwards it live to a Discord
channel via webhook or bot.

## AI Usage
Assist
variant.description: Captures your in-game chat, exports it (txt/json/html/md) and optionally forwards it live to a Discord channel via webhook or bot. Type /easychatlog to open the main window or /easychatlog config for settings.
variant.name: Easy Chatlog
variant.punchline: Export your chat and forward it to Discord.
